name: router-agent-framework
description: A 10-agent framework for monitoring, securing, and optimizing router infrastructure, with an optional bring-your-own-key AI layer.
author: sufiyansrepos

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ragent/agent-protocol && npm run build -w @ragent/ai-core && npm run build -w @ragent/agent-common
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:packages && npm run test:agents
scripts.test:packages: npm run test -w @ragent/agent-protocol && npm run test -w @ragent/ai-core && npm run test -w @ragent/agent-common
scripts.test:agents: npm test -w agent1 --if-present && npm test -w agent2 --if-present && npm test -w agent3 --if-present && npm test -w agent4 --if-present && npm test -w agent5 --if-present && npm test -w agent7 --if-present && npm test -w agent8 --if-present && npm test -w agent9 --if-present && npm test -w agent10 --if-present
